text:
sophie_finance: heads-up: Orchid Bridge invoice #9444 ($8,250) autopay failed - issuer declined at auth window. customer says card works elsewhere. asking if we can accept a same-day wire or virtual card pay link.
payments-bot: [AUTOPAY] invoice=9444 status=failed decline_code=do_not_honor attempts=2 next_retry=2026-06-08T15:00:00Z
kevin_support: Do we have a backup token?
andre_billing: No backup token. Portal shows attempted update but payment couldn't be authorized.
treasury_ops: Virtual card option ok but our vendor fees for VC are higher and reconciliation requires merchant descriptor note. I'd recommend wire for same-day guarantee.
sophie_finance: Customer wants minimum friction and immediate service continuation. They asked for a one-click pay link — can we generate a manual hosted payment link for adhoc card entry that bypasses autopay tokenization?
andre_billing: We can generate a single-use hosted payment link (expires 24h). It still attempts auth with their card and will create a new token if successful. For now, offer link + wire fallback.
kevin_support: I'll message customer: "We can send a one-time pay link now (expires 24h) or provide wire instructions. Which do you prefer? If you pick wire, please include invoice number in reference."
sophie_finance: Also add temporary 48h grace to avoid service interruption while awaiting payment. Approved.
payments-bot: [TICKET] FIN-5207 created for Orchid Bridge manual payment path (hosted link + wire fallback).
kevin_support: Customer replied: "Send hosted link first. If fails, we'll wire."
andre_billing: Generating hosted link now... link generated: https://pay.redwood.com/one-time/9444-xyz (expires in 24h). Sending to customer with instructions.
kevin_support: Sent link and note: "If card fails again, please request wire instructions and include reference: ORCH-9444"
sophie_finance: If they wire later, use internal wire template:
```
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Bank: Pacific Gateway Bank (US)
Routing/ABA: 444000222
Account: 2109876543
SWIFT: PGBKUS66
Reference: ORCH-9444 / Orchid Bridge
Email confirmation (required): settlements@redwood.com
```
andre_billing: Note: require payer legal name and a screenshot of bank confirmation for reconciliation. Once funds post, mark autopay token as blocked for this customer and follow up to re-enroll if they prefer.
treasury_ops: If hosted link succeeds, ensure tokenization flagged as "customer-updated" and not auto-retry for original token.
kevin_support: Customer updated: "Card charged successfully via link. Please confirm receipt and keep service online."
andre_billing: Seeing settlement pending. Will confirm once posted and close FIN-5207. Marking original token as blocked.
sophie_finance: Thanks team 44d closing thread when payment visible in ledger.
